data.name: Collapsed State
data.detailed_description:
Collapsed State is a hardcore, top-down survival RPG that blends the high-stakes inventory management of modern extraction shooters with the tactical, turn-based depth of classic tabletop roleplaying.

Disclaimer: Collapsed State is designed to run OFFLINE on a POTATO🥔

You don't need a high-end gaming PC to run this game. You don't even need an internet connection. Collapsed State is designed to help you get your extraction-shooter fix but without the hassle.

You can purchase the SOURCE CODE to our game💰

Want to make your own version of our game? You can purchase the source code to our project, which gives you the rights to develop your own version of Collapsed State to use commercially or even release yourself on Steam.

Game Features

Collapsed State is a high-strategy looter-shooter. Instead of running and gunning yourself, you'll be managing your survivors and sending them out on raids to the locations you pick. Your job is to manage their loadout, maintain the safehouse, and ultimately... to keep your survivors alive.

Manage Your Inventory

Scavenge the wasteland for food, weapons, and medical supplies. Decide what equipment to take... and what to leave behind. These tiny decisions can be the difference between life and death in a place like this...

Command Your Survivors

Your survivors take the risk... but you collect the rewards. Danger and treachery lurk around every corner, but each of your survivors only have a single life. Take each step wisely...

Protect Your Safehouse

Your sole responsibility is caring for the home that keeps your survivors alive. Keep it well stocked with supplies and ammunition... as a home well-cared for, will take care of you.

data.short_description: Collapsed State is a single player "extraction-lite" RPG set in a post-apocalyptic United States that combines the simplicity of games like Faster than Light with the depth of survival games like Road to Vostok. Get your looter-shooter fix, but without the hassle!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU (Intel i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 class)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD / AMD Radeon iGPU) that supports basic hardware acceleration
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Optional
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU (Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 class)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or stronger integrated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Optional
  • VR Support: None
